messages:
julia_sales: Heads up team 12: Volt Capital just sent an RFI focused on POC acceptance criteria and commercial terms. Key asks: EU data residency during POC, proof of 500 embeddings/sec sustained, SOC2 Type II copy, evidence of canary rollback, and a simple POC SOW template. They also asked about a short-term reserved price for an initial 3-month pilot.

omar_se: Quick clarifying Qs: 1) Is the 500 embeddings/sec target per model endpoint or aggregate? 2) Do they require p95 latency <250ms or is throughput the main metric?

julia_sales: They requested sustained 500/sec aggregate with p95 <300ms during trading-hours window. Pricing note: they'd like a 'pilot discount' if they convert to a 12-month reserved pool.

omar_se: For technical reply: Hosted baseline hits ~320 embeddings/sec with p95 ~260ms on rwd-embed-v1; Dedicated (4xA100 equiv) can exceed 700/s with 4-bit quant + static KV caching. For POC we recommend Dedicated or Private to guarantee residency and deletion certs.

hana_security: I'll prepare a redacted SOC2 bundle and ISO attachments. For hosted we cannot promise HSM-level key custody; we can offer customer-managed KMS via EU key ring in our control plane. For Private we can allow BYOK/HSM. I'll add that to the security answers.

trey_sre: Proposed POC acceptance gates: - Sustained 500 embeddings/sec for 60 minutes - p95 latency <300ms over the same window - KV cache hit-rate >55% - Cold-start median <45s - Canary rollback test: demonstrate 10% rollback to previous model version with <1% error rate. Also include request for SIEM integration for logs.

julia_sales: Perfect. Can someone draft a short POC SOW (2-pager) and include deletion certification language?

omar_se: I'll attach a test harness snippet and measurement steps they can run. Suggest using our curl harness and a simple load generator.

"file-bot": Attached 'voltcap_poc_sow_template.pdf' and 'embed_harness.sh' to the drive link.

hana_security: Legal note: we need customer signature for deletion cert and a copy of the tenant ID to perform a secure wipe. I'll prepare the template.

jorge_sales: I'll send the provisional pilot pricing: Hosted pilot (2 weeks): $5k setup + metered per-1k embeddings. Dedicated 2-week burst reserved: $26k. Year-1 reserved pool discount: up to 20% depending on capacity commitment. Marked as provisional pending infra sizing.

trey_sre: I'll update the capability matrix CSV to include 'POC gates' and 'data residency EU' flags.

file-bot: Uploaded 'capability_matrix_voltcap_v1.csv' (18KB) to thread.
